title: Only Buying Two Tires? The New Pair Usually Goes on the Rear
topic: When replacing only two tires, the newer or deeper-tread pair generally goes on the rear axle
mechanicTruth: Industry guidance generally places the newer or deeper-tread pair on the rear axle when only two tires are replaced, unless vehicle-specific requirements say otherwise, to preserve rear wet-grip stability.
